cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This roof proposal says 'we recommend.' Who's we?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance backed the cheaper tiles. I need your signature to order them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Who authorized Finance to choose the tiles?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The facilities director. Savings go into her office refurbishment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add her approval and that refurbishment to the proposal. Before I sign, can she explain the trade-off to our maintenance team?

mechanism: A corrects a roof proposal collective voice into named support, delegated authority and a documented financial beneficiary before signing.
confusable: D54 seeks effective decision power; D64 specifically uncovers who supports and benefits from a proposal as well as authorisation.
comparison: Workshop alternative exposes a department gaining space; roof alternative makes diverted savings and director authority explicit on paper.
seedUse: We recommend, Finance tiles, facilities director and office refurbishment derive from D64-b; S03 adds exact form-completion standards.
